scope: All seven label slots in 01.DAT1 child0 from the current 0.1.17 ISO.
result: Every current label is represented in unit.targets.json. Mapped entries received independent full and compact wording; all unmapped labels are explicit research flags rather than omissions.
name_policy: Used character_reference_sn6_vita.json spellings for mapped party names. Proper names without a glossary match remain flagged; this pass does not invent official spellings.
layout_policy: Full text records meaning. Compact text is independently chosen at ten ASCII characters or fewer for the measured class field. Canonical proper names are retained rather than arbitrarily truncated.
uncertainties: Many enemy proper names and later class/title labels need glossary-backed spelling or context review before insertion.
The source-local class-title renderings are descriptive English and must not be represented as an official localization.
Some compact variants use game-style abbreviations and need final runtime/font verification.
